# slugify-lite

> URL slugs: unicode to ASCII transliteration for Latin-1/European diacritics, word-boundary truncation, uniqueness helper.

Converts unicode strings to URL-safe slugs via built-in Latin-1/European diacritics transliteration (Crème → creme, Über → uber), lowercase, word-boundary-aware truncation, and a uniqueness helper (base, -2, -3) with custom predicates. Honest coverage: Latin scripts only, not full ICU.

## API

- `slugify(input: string, opts?: {separator?: string, maxLength?: number}): string` — Create slug
- `unique(base: string, taken: (s: string) => boolean, maxAttempts?: number): string` — Ensure uniqueness

## Install

```
npm i slugify-lite
```

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/Ruzylo-cloud/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
